sentences.text: IBAC’s Operation Exmouth investigated allegations that a senior Places Victoria manager improperly awarded work to related businesses under its Fibre to the Home project.
sentences.support: Operation Exmouth investigated allegations that Mr Petrone dishonestly awarded contracts for work under the Fibre to the Home project

sentences.text: IBAC found that the manager helped a related family secure a financial advantage while disregarding procurement and conflict of interest rules.
sentences.support: IBAC’s investigation found that Mr Petrone played a critical role in one family

sentences.text: It also found inadequate guidance and missed opportunities to detect the conduct, but considered the evidence insufficient to substantiate allegations of criminal behaviour.
sentences.support: IBAC considered it was insufficient to substantiate allegations which might amount to criminal behaviour

sentences.text: IBAC made three recommendations on controls and reporting at Places Victoria, and contractors’ understanding of public sector integrity obligations.
sentences.support: The Victorian Public Sector Commission consider ways to inform contractors to the public sector of their obligations

findings.quote: IBAC’s investigation found that Mr Petrone played a critical role in one family (with whom he has a familial relationship) obtaining a large financial advantage through their subcontracting businesses.
After due consideration of the available evidence, IBAC considered it was insufficient to substantiate allegations which might amount to criminal behaviour on the part of Mr Petrone.

notes: The summary distinguishes substantiated improper conduct from the report’s conclusion that evidence was insufficient to substantiate allegations of criminal behaviour. Three numbered recommendations include a reporting requirement.
